plan.name: Staggered Cut-in
plan.summary: B and C sequentially cut into the ego lane ahead, while A progressively brakes. This compresses the ego's forward space, forcing emergency deceleration while maintaining safe following distances.

phases.intent: B cuts in ahead, C holds, A cruises
phases.name: Initial Cut-in

phases.intent: C cuts in behind B, A slows down
phases.name: Gap Compression

phases.intent: A brakes hard, ego forced to stop
phases.name: Emergency Stop
